title: AZDM logged-in legacy real-email resolver fix
changes: Resolve verified real customer email from users/<uid-linked-profile> when Firebase token uses @azobss.local legacy alias.
Fallback to usernameAuthEmails only when the mapping UID matches and AZOBSS profile is already verified.
Keep rejecting accounts with no real email; browser-supplied customer email remains ignored.
Clarify the error message so logged-in state is not mistaken for sign-in failure.
